people.name: Nimrim
people.line: A place in Moab known for its waters

translations.web: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
translations.bsb: The waters of Nimrim are dried up, and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone, and the greenery is no more.
translations.kjv: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
translations.asv: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; for the grass is withered away, the tender grass faileth, there is no green thing.
